bug_semantics: DNSCache._async_add stored every incoming mDNS response record under the lowercased name in cache, _expirations, _expire_heap, and (for DNSService) service_cache with no entry-count cap. RecordManager.async_updates_from_response feeds every non-expired answer from any UDP/5353 multicast packet (224.0.0.251 / ff02::fb) into that path. An unauthenticated LAN peer can flood unique names (RFC 6762 §11, up to 253 bytes) so the maps grow without bound; the only pre-existing controls were a PTR TTL floor (_DNS_PTR_MIN_TTL=1125s) that actually prolongs attacker records and async_expire every _CACHE_CLEANUP_INTERVAL=10s, which cannot keep up. Unique-name floods OOM memory-constrained consumers; a second variant replays cached records with shifting TTLs so _expire_heap grows between cleanups without changing cache/_total_records.
